instrument_case_sensitivity.action_taken: NONE. The gate was NOT modified. Round 1-4 records stand as run.
instrument_case_sensitivity.definition: Quote IS present in T_c; the sole difference is the capitalisation of the first letter (model capitalised a mid-sentence quote). Frozen classify_quote applies NFC + whitespace collapsing but NOT case folding.
instrument_case_sensitivity.interpretation: FALSE REJECTS. Content is correct and verbatim; rejection turns on one uppercase letter. This is an instrument defect, not a generator failure.

model_image_quoting.definition: Quote absent from T_c and from +/-2 neighbouring pages, but PRESENT in OCR of the figure crop. The model quoted text rendered inside the image.
model_image_quoting.interpretation: This is the capability failure the manuscript already reports. The ECM contract eliminated it entirely (0 of 10).

unresolved.caveat: Probably also image-quoting: two are syllogism conclusion lines and one is a diagram label ([diagram label redacted]), which tesseract failed to read off the diagram. NOT counted as confirmed image-quoting because the OCR evidence is absent.
unresolved.definition: Quote absent from text layer and not recovered by crop OCR (overlap 0.0-0.17).

bottom_line: The null is NOT caused by a dataset scoping bug and NOT by a broken model vision.
56% of quote violations are the model quoting image-rendered text - the failure ECM is designed to prevent, and ECM prevented all of them.
22% are FALSE REJECTS from a case-sensitive gate: an instrument defect that penalises every arm and understates admission by 4 items.
The endpoint stays near-constant because of the corpus: figures restate prose. That is a frame property, not a prompt or model property.
boundaries: No frozen code, gate, dataset, or prior-round record was modified. No paid call was made by this audit; it reads sealed sidecars only.

dataset_verdict.T_c_excludes_image_text: BY DESIGN and correct: pdftotext -layout returns the text layer only. This is what makes the gate q subset-of T_c meaningful.
dataset_verdict.T_c_scoping_defect: NOT FOUND. 0 of 18 failed quotes appear on neighbouring pages, so the single-page T_c window is not the cause.
dataset_verdict.real_dataset_limitation: Figures restate prose. 24 of 50 admitted items have an answer >=20 chars verbatim in T_c; 37 of 50 judge records score necessity below 3. This is the corpus property that keeps the endpoint near-constant.
dataset_verdict.rule4_defect_already_fixed: 2 chunks with T_c of 1 and 4 chars were excluded before execution (frozen rule 4).

method: All 22 terminal generation failures recovered from sealed transport sidecars.
Each failed text_evidence_quote re-classified with the FROZEN validator (round2_validation.classify_quote) against the gate's own source_text.
Decisive split 1: search quote in target page AND +/-2 neighbouring pages of the source PDF text layer (pdftotext -layout) -> tests T_c scoping.
Decisive split 2: OCR the figure crops (tesseract -l vie) and test whether the quote is present in image-rendered text -> tests image-quoting.
Split 3: case-insensitive re-match to isolate gate strictness from content error.

model_verdict.contract_compliance: This is the real weakness: unprompted, the model quotes what it sees in the image. 10 of 18 violations.
model_verdict.normalized_verbatim_dominance: 42 of 50 admitted quotes needed NFC/whitespace normalisation; only 8 matched byte-exact. Consistent with a scanned Vietnamese corpus, accepted by design under the D1 repair.
model_verdict.vision_capability: INTACT. Verified items read pie charts and fishbone diagrams correctly, including answers absent from T_c (e.g. CHUNK-8D8C55049A [source fragment redacted]).

prompt_verdict.arm_neutrality: All prompt repairs (D1 validator, D3 option-indexing clarification) were applied identically to all three arms, so no prompt change could have favoured ECM.
prompt_verdict.observed_prompt_effect: The ECM contract text is the only arm-specific difference and it removed image-quoting entirely (0 of 10 vs direct 4, structured 6).

question: Is the round-4 null attributable to dataset, prompt, or model?
